snippet.title: Delivery Mo | Windows Playtest Gameplay
snippet.description:
Official gameplay footage from Delivery Mo, a top-down pixel-art action-adventure. This footage from Windows Playtest 266 shows a completed delivery, Wave Mode and boss combat.

Playtest on itch.io: https://guardianrealms.itch.io/delivery-mo
